title: Torsion Wave Dispersion Relation
plaintext:
TORSION WAVE DISPERSION
=======================
Wave equation: □δT + m²_eff·δT + 3λT_vev·(δT)² = J_spin

Dispersion: ω² = k² + m²_eff   (massive Klein-Gordon type)

Parameters:
  μ² = 9.8275e-3 eV²
  λ_q = 0.000988
  m_eff = 2.3249e-1 eV
  T_vev = 2.2305e+0 m⁻²
  ω = 0.2187 s⁻¹
  k = 0.0100 m⁻¹
  v_group = 0.045742 c   (subluminal ✓)
  Amplitude = -3.238e+0
  J_spin = -3.406e-2
